myGrovia selects swiss-cheese-plant, calathea-orbifolia, snake-plants, and
golden-pothos. Two source entries describe groups including the species shown
in myGrovia, rather than exclusive species records. Display/scientific-name labels,
asset photographs, Easy care and Low light filter flags are supplied by myGrovia.
Descriptions and care tips are retained; light enums become readable text and
temperature arrays become ranges. summerInterval supplies the initial watering
estimate; this is a demo convention, not a climate model or guaranteed schedule.

The selected/adapted plant data and the excerpt in test/fixtures/plants.json are
distributed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The fixture includes metadata and one unrelated
entry to test filtering. This notice concerns the plant dataset, not a claim that
the separate application photographs are supplied or licensed by Plantfolio.

In-app attribution is accessible through My space → Plant data source.
